evidence.says: Dispatcher bg3.exe+0x2DF53B0 case 0x26 (SpellCastConfirmNotificationRequest) creates this component (bg3.exe+0x2DF3A10) and copies the 16 bytes at +0xA0 of the entity's eoc::spell_cast::StateComponent here, as case 0x28 does for SpellCastFailedComponent.SpellCastGuid; then request +8 (12 bytes) at +0x10 and the InitialTarget array at +0x20.

EoCServer.dll+0x83BF10 section for eoc::spell_cast::PreviewEndEventOneFrameComponent + StateComponent (variant tag 0x26) puts at request +8 the StateComponent's optional cast position when it is set (Toolkit offset +0x60, flag +0x6C; Script Extender's CastPosition) and else eoc::spell_cast::GetCasterPosition; dispatcher case 0x26 copies those 12 bytes to +0x10.
padding: nothing is written at +0x1C, the array at +0x20 is 8-aligned

Windows type name ls::FieldMeta<class ls::DynamicArray<struct eoc::spell_cast::InitialTarget,struct ls::TaggedAllocator<int> > eoc::notification::SpellCastConfirmComponent::*,32>; macOS ls::FieldMeta<ls::DynamicArray<eoc::spell_cast::InitialTarget, ls::TaggedAllocator<int> > eoc::notification::SpellCastConfirmComponent::*, &eoc::notification::SpellCastConfirmComponent::m_Targets>. Element stride 0x70 (bg3.exe+0xA9E800) = SE InitialTarget size. Windows replication writer bg3.exe+0x999480 (slot 2 of bg3.exe+0x551A700) passes +0x20 to the array writer bg3.exe+0xA9E800 (count at +0xC, stride 0x70). The element is redeclared here from the Windows element writer (layout = SE InitialTarget).
